[[File:Smuggler_Flight_Pack_package.jpg|250px|thumb|Han Solo with the Smuggler Flight Pack]]
{{Quote|Well it isn't supposed to look pretty!|Han Solo, defending the Flight Pack's appearance|<ref name="Toy">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Deluxe Han Solo|link=POTF2dlxhan.asp}}</ref>}}
The '''Smuggler Flight Pack''' was a custom made, armed [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] built by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to assist in their smuggling operations. The large pack included [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] engines and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] for atmospheric flight, as well as twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] from a damaged [[Light freighter/Legends|stock light freighter]] and a grappling claw for lifting cargo. The pack also included parts from discarded swoops, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and construction-machinery robotics. The grappling claw could lift up to fifteen [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. Solo was sometimes defensive when others criticized the pack's unusual appearance.<ref name="Toy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Smuggler Flight Pack originated as a toy in the collection of deluxe figures released as part of [[Kenner Products|Kenner]]/[[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'']] toy line in [[July]] [[1996]].<ref name="AFF">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>
